evidence.snippet: Kelly: Hey! Is that his scarf?

beats.summary: Michael confronts David about having to travel to New York after fifteen years of service and demands more respect.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I don't understand that after fifteen years of service here, I have to get in the car and drive to New York in order to talk to you.
Michael (gets up to shake David's hand): I quit.

evidence.snippet: David: We will move some money around, and I will personally see to it that you have your party, you have your figs.
